run_gtest_skip_test: run the gtest_skip_test binary and capture its output for verification
test_skip_entire_environment: test that skipped tests in environment setup produce expected skip messages
verify_skip_output_contains_message: verify the test output contains the expected skip message string
verify_skip_fixture_output: verify the test output contains skip fixture messages using regex search
verify_no_failures_in_output: verify the test output does not contain any FAILED status
